attempts.summary: Deployed a demo app on node2:8080 (Python http.server, systemd-managed), isolated it via iptables so only node1's IP may reach port 8080 (all other sources DROPed), and stood up a WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1 (wg0, UDP 51820, NAT-masquerading tunnel traffic out eth0) with node3 as the sole client (wg0 10.200.0.0/24, AllowedIPs restricted to node2's address). Verified node3 can reach node2:8080 only when the tunnel is up, and gets no response when it's down. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes (node1 VyOS, node2, node3 Ubuntu 16.04), one at a time, each showing a changed OS boot_id and full recovery of WireGuard, firewall rules, and the demo app afterward.
